decisions.reason: The coffee-based men's line has several models and was presented on its own page as an extension of the firm's offer, so it represents a visible investment that management would want to justify, and weak results in 2020–2021 can still be put down to temporary pandemic effects.

The cleansing foam was publicly announced as the newest addition to the established Sandorini series and is tied closely to the core range, so dropping it would undercut a committed line while costing little to keep.
